scientific_integrity: Full proof of exact-real mathematical assertions given in RESULT.md; numeric checks are non-certifying. Classical equidistribution is cited. The result is not claimed to have been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Global convergence and basin-width laws require positive gain at most 1/(2π); all-gain counts concern hyperbolic fixed-point sinks only and not higher cycles, physical measures or basin-weighted sampling. Literature priority is best-knowledge, not a uniqueness guarantee.
title: An exact basin-width law and two sink-density transitions in an incommensurate sine map
